comment: Low-resolution page index: what verses are on what pages, for pages outside the high-resolution line-break index (0072B-0085B). de_archive_spread is the number in the archive.org BookReader URL .../page/n<N>/mode/1up, and equals the jp2 file number ../MAM-basics/py/main_cam1753_download_spreads.py uses. A de_text_* field names the text a column was read at, with its _ref companion citing the verse. In the Lamentations entries that text is MAM's LETTERS, UNPOINTED, and deliberately so: an entry records where a verse sits on a page, so pointing it would suggest the pointing had been transcribed off the image as well as the letters, which it has not been and which this manuscript may well do differently. No hand transcription is stored anywhere here; MAM is the source of the letters. The older Ps 18 entries are still pointed and have not been revisited.
